name: defguard - Core
description:
defguard is a true Zero-Trust WireGuard® VPN with 2FA/Multi-Factor Authentication, as each connection requires MFA (and not only when logging in into the client application like other solutions). 
        [br]
        This is the core component of defguard, which may required for the other components to work (gateway, proxy)
requires: Requires a separate Postgres database container. Requires either a separate defguard - Gateway, defguard - Proxy container or openldap container.

variables.name: Postgres - Host
variables.description: Postgres database host

variables.name: Postgres - Port
variables.description: Postgres database port

variables.name: Postgres - User
variables.description: Postgres database user

variables.name: Postgres - Password
variables.description: Postgres database password

variables.name: Postgres - Database
variables.description: Postgres database name

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Used to encrypt private cookies. Run `openssl rand -base64 55 | tr -d '=+/' | tr -d '\n' | cut -c1-64` to generate a random key.

variables.name: Auth Secret
variables.description: Used to encrypt user tokens. Run `openssl rand -base64 55 | tr -d '=+/' | tr -d '\n' | cut -c1-64` to generate a random key.

variables.name: Gateway Secret
variables.description: Used to encrypt gateway tokens. Run `openssl rand -base64 55 | tr -d '=+/' | tr -d '\n' | cut -c1-64` to generate a random key.

variables.name: YubiBridge Secret
variables.description: Used to encrypt YubiBridge tokens. Run `openssl rand -base64 55 | tr -d '=+/' | tr -d '\n' | cut -c1-64` to generate a random key.

variables.name: URL
variables.description: Publicly-accessible URL of defguard instance.

variables.name: Default Admin Password
variables.description: Default password for the admin user.

variables.name: Proxy - Proxy URL
variables.description: Proxy URL of defguard instance. Delete if not using defguard proxy.

variables.name: Proxy - Cookie Domain
variables.description: Set the domain for auth cookies. By default, it's the domain from DEFGUARD_URL. Must be changed to base URL if you want to use forward auth. Delete if not using defguard proxy.

variables.name: LDAP - URL
variables.description: URL of LDAP server. Delete if not using LDAP.

variables.name: LDAP - Bind Username
variables.description: Bind username for LDAP server. Delete if not using LDAP.

variables.name: LDAP - Bind Password
variables.description: Bind password for LDAP server. Delete if not using LDAP.

variables.name: LDAP - User Search Base
variables.description: User search base for LDAP server. Delete if not using LDAP.

variables.name: LDAP - Group Search Base
variables.description: Group search base for LDAP server. Delete if not using LDAP.

variables.name: Cookie Insecure
variables.description: Allow access via HTTP

variables.name: Rust Traceback
variables.description: Enable Rust backtraces

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log level
